title: Hyderabad had 1,372 lakes; nearly half are gone, says CM

slides.head: Hyderabad had 1,372 lakes; nearly half are gone, says CM
What happened
slides.body: The CM said the first phase of the Musi rejuvenation project would begin shortly and that no one would suffer losses.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: He said lost water bodies broke natural drainage, leaving roads and colonies prone to flooding.

slides.head: lakes Hyderabad once had
slides.body: He says the Musi rejuvenation's first phase will begin shortly, but gave no start date.

slides.head: Dig deeper
slides.body: Thammidikunta, which had shrunk to 14 acres, was expanded to 30 acres, the CM said.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: An official start date and route for Musi rejuvenation phase one. Ask: Which lakes near you are on the list for restoration?

slides.head: Spill the tea, daily
slides.body: Hyderabad news in 30 seconds, with the numbers and the questions. Follow for tomorrow's drop: spillthetea.news

captions.instagram:
Hyderabad had 1,372 lakes; nearly half are gone, says CM

At the Thammidikunta lake inauguration, CM Revanth Reddy tied lost lakes to flooding and said Musi work would start soon.

Why it matters: He said lost water bodies broke natural drainage, leaving roads and colonies prone to flooding.

Source: The Hindu. Image: The Hindu
